CommStation|GigiArchitectureMemoryLine09: And then her expression changes again. She's still smiling and I see tears begin to form in the corners of her eyes, but she holds them back.
GigiArchitectureMemoryLine09: And then her expression changes again. She's still smiling and I see tears begin to form in the corners of her eyes, but she holds them back.
CommStation|GigiDetectorReviewLine04: It even works on your map, so be sure to place a bunch and get as much of the Labyrinth covered as possible if you're looking to collect loads of Prisma Plorts, something we'll need when you find me.
GigiDetectorReviewLine04: It even works on your map, so be sure to place a bunch and get as much of the Labyrinth covered as possible if you're looking to collect loads of Prisma Plorts, something we'll need when you find me.
CommStation|GigiDetectorStabilizersLine0: Well, fun if it weren't for the fact that the world around you at the time is likely exploding with dangerous energies and unstable plorts are flying out of your tank...
GigiDetectorStabilizersLine05: Well, fun if it weren't for the fact that the world around you at the time is likely exploding with dangerous energies and unstable plorts are flying out of your tank...
CommStation|GigiDetectorStabilizersLine0: Either way, it's an adventure, right?
GigiDetectorStabilizersLine06: Either way, it's an adventure, right?
CommStation|GigiSecretCreativeLine05: In some ways my arrival to this place was just in time. In time and altogether out of it I suppose..
GigiSecretCreativeLine05: In some ways my arrival to this place was just in time. In time and altogether out of it I suppose..
CommStation|GigiDreamWorldAtmosphereLine: ...I still don't know if it was real or not.
GigiDreamWorldAtmosphereLine07: ...I still don't know if it was real or not.
CommStation|GigiDreamGoldDesertLine06: I spent so many days just huddled in caves trying to find the courage to press on. But I knew I had to. I had to get back to Rainbow Island and find a solution.
GigiDreamGoldDesertLine06: I spent so many days just huddled in caves trying to find the courage to press on. But I knew I had to. I had to get back to Rainbow Island and find a solution.
CommStation|GigiArchitectureMemoryLine10: And then she tells me that she is so sorry my grandmother never had the chance to meet me.
GigiArchitectureMemoryLine10: And then she tells me that she is so sorry my grandmother never had the chance to meet me.
CommStation|GigiArchitectureMemoryLine11: She puts a hand on my shoulder and is about to say something else but the comm station rings and she turns her head.
GigiArchitectureMemoryLine11: She puts a hand on my shoulder and is about to say something else but the comm station rings and she turns her head.
CommStation|GigiArchitectureMemoryLine12: I can't remember anything more after that.
GigiArchitectureMemoryLine12: I can't remember anything more after that.
CommStation|GigiCore_HarmonizerQuestLine: Hi, Beatrix. It looks like there are still some Harmonizers that need to be activated.
GigiCore_HarmonizerQuestLine01: Hi, Beatrix. It looks like there are still some Harmonizers that need to be activated.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_DontStartFig: I need to prepare a bit more.
option.GigiCore_DontStartFight: I need to prepare a bit more.
CommStation|GigiCore_DontStartFightLine0: Come back when you’re ready. I’ll be waiting.
GigiCore_DontStartFightLine01: Come back when you’re ready. I’ll be waiting.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFightConfirmed: Once more, I’m counting on you, Beatrix.
GigiCore_StartFightConfirmedLine01: Once more, I’m counting on you, Beatrix.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_Harmonizers: I really hope so. My guess is that anything unstable or out of place here is a result of the prisma waves blanketing the Labyrinth and transmuting things. If I could invent something to nullify them in just a localized area, it might be enough for you to uncover where the Harmonizers are hidden.
GigiRewardsKiosk_HarmonizersLine01: I really hope so. My guess is that anything unstable or out of place here is a result of the prisma waves blanketing the Labyrinth and transmuting things. If I could invent something to nullify them in just a localized area, it might be enough for you to uncover where the Harmonizers are hidden.
CommStation|option.GigiRewardsKiosk_Opti: How can you build something like that?
option.GigiRewardsKiosk_Options_Plorts: How can you build something like that?
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_PlortsLine0: Well, for starters, I'll need prisma plorts to make the blueprint. I'll need to run all kinds of prisma tests to figure out the parameters we're working with.
GigiRewardsKiosk_PlortsLine01: Well, for starters, I'll need prisma plorts to make the blueprint. I'll need to run all kinds of prisma tests to figure out the parameters we're working with.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKioskLine01: Hello again! I’ve linked this Exchange Station to my facility here, so we can exchange things that you find for things I can make.
GigiRewardsKioskLine01: Hello again! I’ve linked this Exchange Station to my facility here, so we can exchange things that you find for things I can make.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_CoinsLine01: And by the way, I can also exchange prisma plorts for coins you can spend at a kind of underground market... Something I discovered while looking for some of the special tech I needed to build my facility.
GigiRewardsKiosk_CoinsLine01: And by the way, I can also exchange prisma plorts for coins you can spend at a kind of underground market... Something I discovered while looking for some of the special tech I needed to build my facility.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_PlortsLine0: As for actually building it... those strange shadow slimes might be the answer. Their plorts have a natural dampening effect on prisma waves. Maybe they evolved to do that somehow? They can flatten the wavelengths in order to…
GigiRewardsKiosk_PlortsLine02: As for actually building it... those strange shadow slimes might be the answer. Their plorts have a natural dampening effect on prisma waves. Maybe they evolved to do that somehow? They can flatten the wavelengths in order to…
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_PlortsLine0: Sorry, I'm getting caught up in things here. Just keep an eye out for shadow plorts, as they might be useful later. In the meantime, bring me your prisma plorts, and then I can get to work on the nullifier device.
GigiRewardsKiosk_PlortsLine03: Sorry, I'm getting caught up in things here. Just keep an eye out for shadow plorts, as they might be useful later. In the meantime, bring me your prisma plorts, and then I can get to work on the nullifier device.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKioskGoodByeLine0: We're getting closer, Beatrix. Let’s see this thing through.
GigiRewardsKioskGoodByeLine01: We're getting closer, Beatrix. Let’s see this thing through.
CommStation|GigiCore_HydroShowerLine01: I rigged up this hydro shower for emergencies, but there’s no water running to this place, just a lot of pipes. If we can somehow get water running, it will definitely prove useful… trust me.
GigiCore_HydroShowerLine01: I rigged up this hydro shower for emergencies, but there’s no water running to this place, just a lot of pipes. If we can somehow get water running, it will definitely prove useful… trust me.
CommStation|GigiCore_HarmonizerQuestLine: Use the Nullifier to open hidden paths in the Labyrinth. Try looking for walls that look strange, as if they were altered by prisma waves.
GigiCore_HarmonizerQuestLine02: Use the Nullifier to open hidden paths in the Labyrinth. Try looking for walls that look strange, as if they were altered by prisma waves.
CommStation|GigiCore_NeedsWaterTankLine0: Amazing! You activated all the Harmonizers, so we're almost ready to start the process of stabilizing the Prismacore.
GigiCore_NeedsWaterTankLine01: Amazing! You activated all the Harmonizers, so we're almost ready to start the process of stabilizing the Prismacore.
CommStation|GigiCore_NeedsWaterTankLine0: To make this work, we're going to need a lot of water, but it looks like you don't have a water tank. Try crafting one at the Fabricator in the Conservatory, then come back and let me know when you're ready.
GigiCore_NeedsWaterTankLine02: To make this work, we're going to need a lot of water, but it looks like you don't have a water tank. Try crafting one at the Fabricator in the Conservatory, then come back and let me know when you're ready.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFightLine01: This is it, Beatrix. With the Harmonizers activated, and with your help, I can attempt to stabilize the Prismacore.
GigiCore_StartFightLine01: This is it, Beatrix. With the Harmonizers activated, and with your help, I can attempt to stabilize the Prismacore.
CommStation|GigiCore_FightCompleteLine01: Beatrix! All the readings from the Prismacore… they’re stable! It’s on a completely different wavelength than before! I… I can feel it.
GigiCore_FightCompleteLine01: Beatrix! All the readings from the Prismacore… they’re stable! It’s on a completely different wavelength than before! I… I can feel it.
CommStation|GigiCore_IntroLine01: Here it is, Beatrix… the Prismacore.
GigiCore_IntroLine01: Here it is, Beatrix… the Prismacore.
CommStation|GigiCore_IntroLine02: I was breathless when I first saw it. Seeing the way light twisted and moved within it, the way it seemed to change with every moment… It was like staring into the infinite. If I only knew then what would become of it, of me... of everything.
GigiCore_IntroLine02: I was breathless when I first saw it. Seeing the way light twisted and moved within it, the way it seemed to change with every moment… It was like staring into the infinite. If I only knew then what would become of it, of me... of everything.
CommStation|GigiCore_IntroLine03: I’m sorry to have brought you here. To have you pulled you into all this. But it was the only way.
GigiCore_IntroLine03: I’m sorry to have brought you here. To have you pulled you into all this. But it was the only way.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKioskLine02: And like I was saying, I think I can invent something that can uncover hidden areas in the Labyrinth.
GigiRewardsKioskLine02: And like I was saying, I think I can invent something that can uncover hidden areas in the Labyrinth.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_DiscordantW: Keep looking for weird walls. If you use the Nullifier in front of them, it should have some effect and allow you to pass them. Hopefully, you'll find the Harmonizers in there, so we can try to stabilize the Prismacore.
GigiRewardsKiosk_DiscordantWallReminder: Keep looking for weird walls. If you use the Nullifier in front of them, it should have some effect and allow you to pass them. Hopefully, you'll find the Harmonizers in there, so we can try to stabilize the Prismacore.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_PlortRemind: I’m counting on you to get those plorts so I can develop the Nullifier blueprint. It’s a shot in the dark, but we have to hold on to hope, Beatrix.
GigiRewardsKiosk_PlortReminder: I’m counting on you to get those plorts so I can develop the Nullifier blueprint. It’s a shot in the dark, but we have to hold on to hope, Beatrix.
CommStation|GigiCore_FightCompleteLine02: It will take a long time for the land to fully heal and effects like prisma disruptions to stop. But Rainbow Island — no, the future of the whole Far, Far Range has been saved. You did it, Beatrix. We did it. And I can’t thank you enough.
GigiCore_FightCompleteLine02: It will take a long time for the land to fully heal and effects like prisma disruptions to stop. But Rainbow Island — no, the future of the whole Far, Far Range has been saved. You did it, Beatrix. We did it. And I can’t thank you enough.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_HarmonizerR: Now that you have my Nullifier gadget blueprint, go ahead and craft it at the Fabricator in the Conservatory. Then it’s up to you to start looking for those hidden areas behind strange walls.
GigiRewardsKiosk_HarmonizerReminder: Now that you have my Nullifier gadget blueprint, go ahead and craft it at the Fabricator in the Conservatory. Then it’s up to you to start looking for those hidden areas behind strange walls.
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_CoinsLine02: But never mind that. The important part right now is working on that nullifying device. So go get those plorts!
GigiRewardsKiosk_CoinsLine02: But never mind that. The important part right now is working on that nullifying device. So go get those plorts!
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_PostGameDia: Recorded message: Hi, Beatrix! I've left the Exchange Station on automatic. You can deposit prisma plorts to get rainbow coins whenever you want. Have fun!
GigiRewardsKiosk_PostGameDialogLine01: Recorded message: Hi, Beatrix! I've left the Exchange Station on automatic. You can deposit prisma plorts to get rainbow coins whenever you want. Have fun!
CommStation|GigiRewardsKiosk_BossFightPr: This is a recorded message: You’ve activated all the Harmonizers! Please come talk to me over by the Prismacore. Now the real work begins…
GigiRewardsKiosk_BossFightPromptLine01: This is a recorded message: You’ve activated all the Harmonizers! Please come talk to me over by the Prismacore. Now the real work begins…
CommStation|GigiCore_RetryFightLine01: Thank goodness you’re back. I was able to shut down the process and clear the room just in time. Really glad I installed that emergency shower!
GigiCore_RetryFightLine01: Thank goodness you’re back. I was able to shut down the process and clear the room just in time. Really glad I installed that emergency shower!
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumLine01: Hi, Beatrix. I've been calling this area the Terrarium.
GigiEnteringTerrariumLine01: Hi, Beatrix. I've been calling this area the Terrarium.
CommStation|option.GigiEnteringTerrarium: I'll head on in to check it out right now.
option.GigiEnteringTerrariumGoodbye: I'll head on in to check it out right now.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrari: Well... you know, a terrarium is just a container that keeps plants outside of their usual environment.
GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrariumLine01: Well... you know, a terrarium is just a container that keeps plants outside of their usual environment.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrari: The first time I came through here, that's what it looked like to me. Just a biosphere, though a really beautiful one, with unique food and slimes.
GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrariumLine02: The first time I came through here, that's what it looked like to me. Just a biosphere, though a really beautiful one, with unique food and slimes.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrari: And... maybe that's true. It's possible that this is just a way to represent the outside world here in the Labyrinth, safely behind glass.
GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrariumLine03: And... maybe that's true. It's possible that this is just a way to represent the outside world here in the Labyrinth, safely behind glass.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrari: But... I'm no longer so sure.
GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrariumLine04: But... I'm no longer so sure.
CommStation|option.GigiEnteringTerrarium: So what do you think it really is?
option.GigiEnteringTerrariumTerrariumThe: So what do you think it really is?
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTheorie: That's the thing, Beatrix. I have no way of knowing, not really. But...
GigiEnteringTerrariumTheoriesLine01: That's the thing, Beatrix. I have no way of knowing, not really. But...
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTheorie: I'm very sure the Labyrinth as a whole is a facility that was intended to contain and stabilize the Prismacore. So logically, the Terrarium is here for some Prismacore-related reason.
GigiEnteringTerrariumTheoriesLine02: I'm very sure the Labyrinth as a whole is a facility that was intended to contain and stabilize the Prismacore. So logically, the Terrarium is here for some Prismacore-related reason.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTheorie: And if I think about what that could be...
GigiEnteringTerrariumTheoriesLine03: And if I think about what that could be...
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTheorie: I wonder if it's a seed bank of some kind. Like, if things went really bad in the future, if the Prismacore became too unstable and really, truly breached... this would be a way to ensure that some of the flora would survive the ensuing calamity.
GigiEnteringTerrariumTheoriesLine04: I wonder if it's a seed bank of some kind. Like, if things went really bad in the future, if the Prismacore became too unstable and really, truly breached... this would be a way to ensure that some of the flora would survive the ensuing calamity.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumTheorie: If so, that would mean the Terrarium is basically, well, an insurance policy, so that if the worst happens, there could be a do-over.
GigiEnteringTerrariumTheoriesLine05: If so, that would mean the Terrarium is basically, well, an insurance policy, so that if the worst happens, there could be a do-over.
CommStation|option.GigiEnteringTerrarium: What part of that do you relate to?
option.GigiEnteringTerrariumTheoriesMist: What part of that do you relate to?
CommStation|option.GigiEnteringTerrarium: I'll try to stop it before it gets to that.
option.GigiEnteringTerrariumTheoriesGood: I'll try to stop it before it gets to that.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumMistake: O-of course I want to think that my actions in the past might help save the future. I mean, I think it's natural to want to set things up so the future can be better, even if there's no way to know for sure what helps.
GigiEnteringTerrariumMistakeLine03: O-of course I want to think that my actions in the past might help save the future. I mean, I think it's natural to want to set things up so the future can be better, even if there's no way to know for sure what helps.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumMistake: If you think of it another way: to all those who exist in the future, what's happening right now is the past. We want those people of the future to look back at what we're doing and feel like it made all the difference to them.
GigiEnteringTerrariumMistakeLine05: If you think of it another way: to all those who exist in the future, what's happening right now is the past. We want those people of the future to look back at what we're doing and feel like it made all the difference to them.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumMistake: Or, better yet, we want to make it so they never had to worry in the first place.
GigiEnteringTerrariumMistakeLine06: Or, better yet, we want to make it so they never had to worry in the first place.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumMistake: What we do here will make all the difference eventually. I have to believe that.
GigiEnteringTerrariumMistakeLine07: What we do here will make all the difference eventually. I have to believe that.
CommStation|option.GigiEnteringTerrarium: All we can do is live in the moment. I'll head onward.
option.GigiEnteringTerrariumMistakeGoodb: All we can do is live in the moment. I'll head onward.
CommStation|GigiEnteringTerrariumGoodbye: Things are in a bad state, but... there's a lot to see and love here. I hope you can take the time to enjoy it, too.
GigiEnteringTerrariumGoodbyeLine01: Things are in a bad state, but... there's a lot to see and love here. I hope you can take the time to enjoy it, too.
CommStation|option.GigiMiniatureMuseumMu: It's almost like some kind of museum!
option.GigiMiniatureMuseumMuseum: It's almost like some kind of museum!
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumMuseumLin: That might be what glass cases say to us, but I believe they're here for another purpose. Actually, I'm convinced that they have something to do with the manipulation of time.
GigiMiniatureMuseumMuseumLine01: That might be what glass cases say to us, but I believe they're here for another purpose. Actually, I'm convinced that they have something to do with the manipulation of time.
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumMuseumLin: I've observed the ones with plants for a while, and I've noticed that time's moving faster inside these cases than outside of them.
GigiMiniatureMuseumMuseumLine02: I've observed the ones with plants for a while, and I've noticed that time's moving faster inside these cases than outside of them.
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumMuseumLin: I think that it must be some way of analyzing the Prismacore's effects on the natural world. Perhaps they're a way to help predict what would happen in the event of a breach.
GigiMiniatureMuseumMuseumLine03: I think that it must be some way of analyzing the Prismacore's effects on the natural world. Perhaps they're a way to help predict what would happen in the event of a breach.
CommStation|option.GigiMiniatureMuseumMu: Is it happening with the tiny buildings too?
option.GigiMiniatureMuseumMuseumBuilding: Is it happening with the tiny buildings too?
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildings: It might be, but I'm not sure.
GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildingsLine01: It might be, but I'm not sure.
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildings: Maybe it is, or maybe it's manipulating space instead... or even a third thing that's so alien to us that we'll never have the context to figure it out
GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildingsLine02: Maybe it is, or maybe it's manipulating space instead... or even a third thing that's so alien to us that we'll never have the context to figure it out
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildings: There are so many mysteries on Rainbow Island, Beatrix, and I don't think we'll solve even half of them in our lifetimes.
GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildingsLine03: There are so many mysteries on Rainbow Island, Beatrix, and I don't think we'll solve even half of them in our lifetimes.
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildings: Sometimes all you can do is look through the glass and wonder about what's happening on the other side.
GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildingsLine04: Sometimes all you can do is look through the glass and wonder about what's happening on the other side.
CommStation|option.GigiMiniatureMuseumBu: Do you feel that way often?
option.GigiMiniatureMuseumBuildingsCase: Do you feel that way often?
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseLine0: I've felt that way for a long time, honestly.
GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseLine01: I've felt that way for a long time, honestly.
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseLine0: You know, my whole life was planned out: I'd grow up and then take over the ranch, just like my mom took over from Grandma. One day, I'd pass the ranch down to a child of my own. It was all meant with such love. A beautiful home, our family legacy.
GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseLine02: You know, my whole life was planned out: I'd grow up and then take over the ranch, just like my mom took over from Grandma. One day, I'd pass the ranch down to a child of my own. It was all meant with such love. A beautiful home, our family legacy.
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseLine0: To me, it was such a small world, like being in one of these domes here, pressing my hands against the glass and imagining the life I'd be living if I hadn't been born on a ranch.
GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseLine03: To me, it was such a small world, like being in one of these domes here, pressing my hands against the glass and imagining the life I'd be living if I hadn't been born on a ranch.
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseLine0: I came here to Rainbow Island to try to live that other life. But I'm trapped again now, this time for real. Isn't it ironic? I'm behind glass, shut away like everything else in here.
GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseLine04: I came here to Rainbow Island to try to live that other life. But I'm trapped again now, this time for real. Isn't it ironic? I'm behind glass, shut away like everything else in here.
CommStation|option.GigiMiniatureMuseumCa: I'll head out to help free you as soon as I can.
option.GigiMiniatureMuseumCaseGoodbye: I'll head out to help free you as soon as I can.
CommStation|GigiMiniatureMuseumGoodbyeLi: I know we have to hurry, but take some time to enjoy what's in front of you, too.
GigiMiniatureMuseumGoodbyeLine01: I know we have to hurry, but take some time to enjoy what's in front of you, too.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomLine01: Oh no... there's gold here. So even the Terrarium is starting to be affected. At least it's probably still a useful shortcut.
GigiOutsideGold RoomLine01: Oh no... there's gold here. So even the Terrarium is starting to be affected. At least it's probably still a useful shortcut.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomRisksLin: Anywhere close to the Prismacore can be affected by its reality-altering properties. Materials changing from one to another, switching from solid to liquid or gas, flickering entirely out of existence...
GigiOutsideGold RoomRisksLine01: Anywhere close to the Prismacore can be affected by its reality-altering properties. Materials changing from one to another, switching from solid to liquid or gas, flickering entirely out of existence...
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomRisksLin: Outside the Labyrinth, it's seemingly harmless changes, but here, it's more dangerous. Imagine if the section of the floor you're standing on vanished under you, or if the only door out became a wall of solid rock...
GigiOutsideGold RoomRisksLine02: Outside the Labyrinth, it's seemingly harmless changes, but here, it's more dangerous. Imagine if the section of the floor you're standing on vanished under you, or if the only door out became a wall of solid rock...
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomRisksLin: And the gold... that seems to be the most potent of the transmutations, and it's probably the fate of this world if left unchecked.
GigiOutsideGold RoomRisksLine03: And the gold... that seems to be the most potent of the transmutations, and it's probably the fate of this world if left unchecked.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomRisksLin: It all feels like King Midas from my storybooks.
GigiOutsideGold RoomRisksLine04: It all feels like King Midas from my storybooks.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomMidasLin: It's an old myth about a king named Midas who wished to have all he touched turn to gold. He became rich beyond measure, but soon discovered that he could no longer eat or drink, and withered away.
GigiOutsideGold RoomMidasLine01: It's an old myth about a king named Midas who wished to have all he touched turn to gold. He became rich beyond measure, but soon discovered that he could no longer eat or drink, and withered away.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomMidasLin: When I first discovered the Prismacore, I was horrified at seeing the whole ecosystem turning to gold. I called for help, but those that arrived saw only the value of that gold.
GigiOutsideGold RoomMidasLine02: When I first discovered the Prismacore, I was horrified at seeing the whole ecosystem turning to gold. I called for help, but those that arrived saw only the value of that gold.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomMidasLin: ...It ended in disaster when they tried to harness its full power. I won't let that happen again. We can't.
GigiOutsideGold RoomMidasLine03: ...It ended in disaster when they tried to harness its full power. I won't let that happen again. We can't.
CommStation|option.GigiOutsideGold RoomM: So I should hurry and make use of that shortcut?
option.GigiOutsideGold RoomMidasShortcut: So I should hurry and make use of that shortcut?
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomShortcut: Right, I remember there being one there. Though my memory isn't that reliable these days.
GigiOutsideGold RoomShortcutsLine01: Right, I remember there being one there. Though my memory isn't that reliable these days.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomShortcut: Shortcuts are funny things. Space and time are both full of shortcuts, when you think about it — I mean, I used my memories of the area and quantum tech to set up these projectors. That's a kind of time-based shortcut.
GigiOutsideGold RoomShortcutsLine02: Shortcuts are funny things. Space and time are both full of shortcuts, when you think about it — I mean, I used my memories of the area and quantum tech to set up these projectors. That's a kind of time-based shortcut.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomShortcut: Physical shortcuts are maybe more recognizable. Knowing there are quick ways back to places you've been before... it can make all the difference, right? It can completely change what you'd otherwise do. I know it has for me.
GigiOutsideGold RoomShortcutsLine03: Physical shortcuts are maybe more recognizable. Knowing there are quick ways back to places you've been before... it can make all the difference, right? It can completely change what you'd otherwise do. I know it has for me.
CommStation|GigiOutsideGold RoomShortcut: Though I suppose we often find ourselves in the same place in the end, one way or another.
GigiOutsideGold RoomShortcutsLine04: Though I suppose we often find ourselves in the same place in the end, one way or another.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeLine01: Beatrix, look out the window. There's so much more out there than I'd realized.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeLine01: Beatrix, look out the window. There's so much more out there than I'd realized.
CommStation|option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeTre: So why did you put the projector here?
option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeTree: So why did you put the projector here?
CommStation|option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeGoo: It's amazing... but I'd better press on.
option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeGoodbye: It's amazing... but I'd better press on.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLi: I haven't. I don't remember seeing anything out those windows. I saw it for the first time just now when you activated the projector.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLine01: I haven't. I don't remember seeing anything out those windows. I saw it for the first time just now when you activated the projector.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLi: You know, back then, I really thought I'd walked through the whole facility. I was pretty sure I'd had this whole place mapped out.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLine02: You know, back then, I really thought I'd walked through the whole facility. I was pretty sure I'd had this whole place mapped out.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLi: But times like now, I catch glimpses of what feels like an infinite expanse out there, labyrinth as far as the eye can see. Was it here the whole time and I just... missed it?
GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLine03: But times like now, I catch glimpses of what feels like an infinite expanse out there, labyrinth as far as the eye can see. Was it here the whole time and I just... missed it?
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLi: Maybe it wasn't, though. It might be made using quantum architecture. That means it could be here in a moment and then gone in a flash... or even both here and not here at the same time.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLine04: Maybe it wasn't, though. It might be made using quantum architecture. That means it could be here in a moment and then gone in a flash... or even both here and not here at the same time.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLi: I mean, I make use of quantum tech often enough myself. It'd be foolish to overlook the possibility.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityLine05: I mean, I make use of quantum tech often enough myself. It'd be foolish to overlook the possibility.
CommStation|option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeFac: How have you been using quantum tech?
option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityQuantum: How have you been using quantum tech?
CommStation|option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeFac: I feel like I should move on before this place vanishes too.
option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeFacilityGoodbye: I feel like I should move on before this place vanishes too.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumLin: Oh, a few ways. You're interacting with one right now.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumLine01: Oh, a few ways. You're interacting with one right now.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumLin: The projectors themselves aren't quantum in nature, but how I placed them was. You've been unlocking all sorts of gates to get here, right? Well, it's not that I've gone through, placed things, and then locked up again behind myself.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumLine02: The projectors themselves aren't quantum in nature, but how I placed them was. You've been unlocking all sorts of gates to get here, right? Well, it's not that I've gone through, placed things, and then locked up again behind myself.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumLin: Back when I first came here, it was all open and unlocked, so I wandered all over the place. I've used quantum technology to place the projectors in places I remember having seen.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumLine03: Back when I first came here, it was all open and unlocked, so I wandered all over the place. I've used quantum technology to place the projectors in places I remember having seen.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumLin: Though... my memory isn't as reliable as it used to be, so some of them may have gotten lost in transit. I guess we'll find out if and when you activate them.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumLine04: Though... my memory isn't as reliable as it used to be, so some of them may have gotten lost in transit. I guess we'll find out if and when you activate them.
CommStation|option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeQua: So what memory did you use to place this one?
option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumTree: So what memory did you use to place this one?
CommStation|option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeQua: I'll keep looking for the rest, then.
option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeQuantumGoodbye: I'll keep looking for the rest, then.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine01: Well, I placed this one because I remembered this lovely little tree. Strangely, a memory came back to me all of a sudden...
GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine01: Well, I placed this one because I remembered this lovely little tree. Strangely, a memory came back to me all of a sudden...
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine02: So, there was this one Tabby Slime that was always hanging around the ranch back home. It was just a wild slime, but it came around all the time, and by the afternoon would always just bounce away again.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine02: So, there was this one Tabby Slime that was always hanging around the ranch back home. It was just a wild slime, but it came around all the time, and by the afternoon would always just bounce away again.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine03: And one day... I decided to follow it.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine03: And one day... I decided to follow it.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine04: It took me deep into the woods. After a while, it did a wiggle at this huge tree and then began to climb it, just jiggling its way from branch to branch all the way up.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine04: It took me deep into the woods. After a while, it did a wiggle at this huge tree and then began to climb it, just jiggling its way from branch to branch all the way up.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine05: I followed it. Partway up, I lost sight of the slime, but I kept climbing. Soon enough, I broke the tree cover, and... oh, Beatrix, I don't know how to put it into words.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine05: I followed it. Partway up, I lost sight of the slime, but I kept climbing. Soon enough, I broke the tree cover, and... oh, Beatrix, I don't know how to put it into words.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine06: I'd never been so high up, and I'd never seen so much of the big, wide world. My entire life had been in the acres around my home, and there I could see just... everything. Trees blanketing the Far, Far Range, birds flying above...
GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine06: I'd never been so high up, and I'd never seen so much of the big, wide world. My entire life had been in the acres around my home, and there I could see just... everything. Trees blanketing the Far, Far Range, birds flying above...
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine07: It took my breath away. I stayed up there for hours until my mom came looking for me. Boy, did she give me an earful.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine07: It took my breath away. I stayed up there for hours until my mom came looking for me. Boy, did she give me an earful.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine08: It wouldn't be the last time I disappeared on her to see the wider world...
GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeLine08: It wouldn't be the last time I disappeared on her to see the wider world...
CommStation|option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeTre: We'll get you out to see the world again.
option.GigiAlcoveWithTreeTreeGoodbye: We'll get you out to see the world again.
CommStation|GigiAlcoveWithTreeGoodbyeLin: Better make like a tree and leave, then. See you, Beatrix.
GigiAlcoveWithTreeGoodbyeLine01: Better make like a tree and leave, then. See you, Beatrix.
CommStation|GigiCore_PostGame03: I want to start by thanking you again. Because of you this world has a future. We all do.
GigiCore_PostGame03: I want to start by thanking you again. Because of you this world has a future. We all do.
CommStation|GigiCore_PostGame02: I’m sorry to have made this a recording, but I needed to move on, and saying that I’m bad with goodbyes is definitely an understatement.
GigiCore_PostGame02: I’m sorry to have made this a recording, but I needed to move on, and saying that I’m bad with goodbyes is definitely an understatement.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_LocationExpla: I’m afraid I still can’t greet you in person. I would have loved to thank you properly. But I’ve locked myself away in the facility on the other side of this room. I’ll try to explain everything. After all you’ve been through to get here, I at least owe you that much.
GigiCore_Intro_LocationExplainLine01: I’m afraid I still can’t greet you in person. I would have loved to thank you properly. But I’ve locked myself away in the facility on the other side of this room. I’ll try to explain everything. After all you’ve been through to get here, I at least owe you that much.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_LocationExpla: So let’s start over. My name is…
GigiCore_Intro_LocationExplainLine02: So let’s start over. My name is…
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_LocationExpla: I’m the granddaughter of Hobson and Thora.
GigiCore_Intro_LocationExplainLine04: I’m the granddaughter of Hobson and Thora.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_TimeTravelExp: You might not believe this, but… the short answer is that I’m from the future. In my time, I discovered Rainbow Island and the Prismacore, and… things went badly. It was rapidly destabilizing, and when I tried to fix it, I only made it worse. I called the wrong people to help, and they tried to exploit its unnatural power.
GigiCore_Intro_TimeTravelExplainLine01: You might not believe this, but… the short answer is that I’m from the future. In my time, I discovered Rainbow Island and the Prismacore, and… things went badly. It was rapidly destabilizing, and when I tried to fix it, I only made it worse. I called the wrong people to help, and they tried to exploit its unnatural power.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_TimeTravelExp: Everything quickly fell apart after that. There was an explosion. Prismatic light tore across Rainbow Island and into the atmosphere of the Far, Far Range. I shielded myself from the blast, but my arm… something happened.
GigiCore_Intro_TimeTravelExplainLine02: Everything quickly fell apart after that. There was an explosion. Prismatic light tore across Rainbow Island and into the atmosphere of the Far, Far Range. I shielded myself from the blast, but my arm… something happened.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_IntroOptions: But if you’re here, what about back… home?
option.GigiCore_IntroOptions_Home: But if you’re here, what about back… home?
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_HomeExplainLi: My world — the Far, Far Range in my time… it’s on the brink of disaster. The Prismacore’s energy has blanketed the atmosphere and has begun to warp the environment as it has here: changing trees to metal, water to glass, and even phasing the natural world out of reality.
GigiCore_Intro_HomeExplainLine01: My world — the Far, Far Range in my time… it’s on the brink of disaster. The Prismacore’s energy has blanketed the atmosphere and has begun to warp the environment as it has here: changing trees to metal, water to glass, and even phasing the natural world out of reality.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_HomeExplainLi: In time, there will be nothing left to sustain the ecosystem. Faced with that… knowing that I had a hand in causing it all… I had to do something.
GigiCore_Intro_HomeExplainLine02: In time, there will be nothing left to sustain the ecosystem. Faced with that… knowing that I had a hand in causing it all… I had to do something.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_TimeTravelExp: The energy from the Prismacore imprinted itself on me. I can feel it coursing in my arm despite my efforts to contain it. It’s why I’ve sealed myself away and needed your help: when I get near the Prismacore it causes the destabilization to accelerate, like it’s reacting to its own energy signature.
GigiCore_Intro_TimeTravelExplainLine03: The energy from the Prismacore imprinted itself on me. I can feel it coursing in my arm despite my efforts to contain it. It’s why I’ve sealed myself away and needed your help: when I get near the Prismacore it causes the destabilization to accelerate, like it’s reacting to its own energy signature.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_IntroOptions: So how did you… travel here?
option.GigiCore_IntroOptions_GlassDesert: So how did you… travel here?
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_GlassDesertLi: Remember during your previous journey in the Glass Desert, where my grandfather led you to a “portal beyond space and time?” When you got there, it seemed like it was ruined.
GigiCore_Intro_GlassDesertLine01: Remember during your previous journey in the Glass Desert, where my grandfather led you to a “portal beyond space and time?” When you got there, it seemed like it was ruined.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_GlassDesertLi: Well, that’s because I had already used it. I was able to direct the one in my world to this point in our timeline. There was just one problem…
GigiCore_Intro_GlassDesertLine02: Well, that’s because I had already used it. I was able to direct the one in my world to this point in our timeline. There was just one problem…
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_GlassDesertLi: …It crumbled from the shock of activating when I arrived. I didn’t realize it would be a one way trip.
GigiCore_Intro_GlassDesertLine03: …It crumbled from the shock of activating when I arrived. I didn’t realize it would be a one way trip.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_StuckLine01: Yes. Perhaps there’s a way of repairing the portal, but like so many things here, it’s beyond my understanding. So I have to accept that I will never return home... never see my family again.
GigiCore_Intro_StuckLine01: Yes. Perhaps there’s a way of repairing the portal, but like so many things here, it’s beyond my understanding. So I have to accept that I will never return home... never see my family again.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_StuckLine02: But it will be worth it if we can somehow stabilize the Prismacore. If we can do that, then not only do we save everything here and now, but it will fix my mistakes in the future. I have to believe that.
GigiCore_Intro_StuckLine02: But it will be worth it if we can somehow stabilize the Prismacore. If we can do that, then not only do we save everything here and now, but it will fix my mistakes in the future. I have to believe that.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_IntroOptions: How do we stabilize the Prismacore?
option.GigiCore_IntroOptions_Stabilize: How do we stabilize the Prismacore?
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_StabilizeLine: In my research here, I have discovered that whoever built the Grey Labyrinth created devices called Harmonizers designed to stabilize the Prismacore… only they just didn’t work. There’s evidence that it was attempted multiple times, each time having the opposite effect and making the situation worse.
GigiCore_Intro_StabilizeLine01: In my research here, I have discovered that whoever built the Grey Labyrinth created devices called Harmonizers designed to stabilize the Prismacore… only they just didn’t work. There’s evidence that it was attempted multiple times, each time having the opposite effect and making the situation worse.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_AdviceLine01: Oh? What did he say? Never give up? To keep pushing through when all the odds are stacked against you? My mom always said grandpa had a way with words.
GigiCore_Intro_AdviceLine01: Oh? What did he say? Never give up? To keep pushing through when all the odds are stacked against you? My mom always said grandpa had a way with words.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_IntroOptions: But if they didn’t work before, how will it work this time?
option.GigiCore_IntroOptions_Difference: But if they didn’t work before, how will it work this time?
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_DifferenceLin: I’ll have to explain later. But I think I have something that maybe they didn’t… something that might allow it to work this time.
GigiCore_Intro_DifferenceLine01: I’ll have to explain later. But I think I have something that maybe they didn’t… something that might allow it to work this time.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_DifferenceLin: There’s only one problem: the Harmonizers are lost. There’s no record of where they are located. Heck, there’s no record of what they even look like. I am completely in the dark here and don’t know what to do.
GigiCore_Intro_DifferenceLine02: There’s only one problem: the Harmonizers are lost. There’s no record of where they are located. Heck, there’s no record of what they even look like. I am completely in the dark here and don’t know what to do.
CommStation|GigiCore_PostGame04: Because of you I can dream again, dream about a life I can call my own. Because of you I can finally live as who I was always meant to be.
GigiCore_PostGame04: Because of you I can dream again, dream about a life I can call my own. Because of you I can finally live as who I was always meant to be.
CommStation|GigiCore_PostGame05: But there’s still more I need to do. I need to study the ecosystem and ensure that it too can move on despite the damages it endured. But I also need to walk barefoot in the grass. To smell flowers in the wind.
GigiCore_PostGame05: But there’s still more I need to do. I need to study the ecosystem and ensure that it too can move on despite the damages it endured. But I also need to walk barefoot in the grass. To smell flowers in the wind.
CommStation|GigiCore_PostGame06: I need to be still and watch the clouds crawl slowly across the sky. And I need to visit a friend and play Go well into the night.
GigiCore_PostGame06: I need to be still and watch the clouds crawl slowly across the sky. And I need to visit a friend and play Go well into the night.
CommStation|GigiCore_PostGame07: I need to just live, Beatrix.
GigiCore_PostGame07: I need to just live, Beatrix.
CommStation|GigiCore_PostGame08: The Conservatory is yours now. I know it’s in good hands. The way you have cared for it, for the silly little creatures of this world, and the way you so selflessly aided me here…
GigiCore_PostGame08: The Conservatory is yours now. I know it’s in good hands. The way you have cared for it, for the silly little creatures of this world, and the way you so selflessly aided me here…
CommStation|GigiCore_PostGame09: You have a very good heart, Beatrix LeBeau. And I am very happy to have met you.
GigiCore_PostGame09: You have a very good heart, Beatrix LeBeau. And I am very happy to have met you.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFightLine02: It works like this: the Prismacore is constantly emitting a chaotic array of energy waves that seemingly take the form of color in our world. But it’s totally out of sync with our world, in a way that runs deep, like in an elemental way. That’s how it warps reality around it.
GigiCore_StartFightLine02: It works like this: the Prismacore is constantly emitting a chaotic array of energy waves that seemingly take the form of color in our world. But it’s totally out of sync with our world, in a way that runs deep, like in an elemental way. That’s how it warps reality around it.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFightLine03: But this is where you come in. The Harmonizers you activated emit a special energy pulse that reverberates through the whole of the Labyrinth. Combined, they form a kind of harmonious energy wave, and when directed at the Prismacore, it attempts to change it, to make it harmonious too.
GigiCore_StartFightLine03: But this is where you come in. The Harmonizers you activated emit a special energy pulse that reverberates through the whole of the Labyrinth. Combined, they form a kind of harmonious energy wave, and when directed at the Prismacore, it attempts to change it, to make it harmonious too.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_StartFightOp: But you said it was attempted before and never worked?
option.GigiCore_StartFightOptions_Arm: But you said it was attempted before and never worked?
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_ArmLine0: Yes, that’s true. But I think I have something that the architects of this system did not: my arm.
GigiCore_StartFight_ArmLine01: Yes, that’s true. But I think I have something that the architects of this system did not: my arm.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_ArmLine0: I can feel the energy waves of the Prismacore in my arm. I can feel its chaos… and so I think I will be able to change its wavelength and create that harmony. Because I’ll be able to feel it myself.
GigiCore_StartFight_ArmLine02: I can feel the energy waves of the Prismacore in my arm. I can feel its chaos… and so I think I will be able to change its wavelength and create that harmony. Because I’ll be able to feel it myself.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_StartFightOp: Ok, what do you need me to do?
option.GigiCore_StartFightOptions_Tarr: Ok, what do you need me to do?
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_TarrLine: Once you’re ready, I’ll begin overlaying the Harmonizer’s wavelengths onto the Prismacore. This will cause incredible disruptions and send the Prismacore into a state of chaos until we can actually stabilize it.
GigiCore_StartFight_TarrLine01: Once you’re ready, I’ll begin overlaying the Harmonizer’s wavelengths onto the Prismacore. This will cause incredible disruptions and send the Prismacore into a state of chaos until we can actually stabilize it.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_TarrLine: This chaos will have a volatile effect on the world around us, transmuting even slimes into masses of horrible Tarr that will fill this room and ultimately destroy everything unless we do something about it.
GigiCore_StartFight_TarrLine02: This chaos will have a volatile effect on the world around us, transmuting even slimes into masses of horrible Tarr that will fill this room and ultimately destroy everything unless we do something about it.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_TarrLine: I’ll need you to fight back and destroy all the Tarr before they destabilize the Prismacore and take us down with it. Normally, water can’t exist here for long. It turns to glass this close to the Prismacore.
GigiCore_StartFight_TarrLine03: I’ll need you to fight back and destroy all the Tarr before they destabilize the Prismacore and take us down with it. Normally, water can’t exist here for long. It turns to glass this close to the Prismacore.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_TarrLine: But the Harmonizers resonate through the water that flows here now. So grab it when you can and wipe out those Tarr!
GigiCore_StartFight_TarrLine04: But the Harmonizers resonate through the water that flows here now. So grab it when you can and wipe out those Tarr!
CommStation|option.GigiCore_StartFightOp: What if things get really out of hand?
option.GigiCore_StartFightOptions_Failsa: What if things get really out of hand?
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_Failsafe: I’ve got you covered! I’ve rigged a hydro shower above the Prismacore. It only needs to build up enough pressure to be used. So to do that, pack it full of slimes! Not only might it save the day, but you’ll save some slimes with it.
GigiCore_StartFight_FailsafeLine01: I’ve got you covered! I’ve rigged a hydro shower above the Prismacore. It only needs to build up enough pressure to be used. So to do that, pack it full of slimes! Not only might it save the day, but you’ll save some slimes with it.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_Failsafe: Also, I’ll store the contents of your vac tank during the process so you’ll have plenty of room for slimes.
GigiCore_StartFight_FailsafeLine02: Also, I’ll store the contents of your vac tank during the process so you’ll have plenty of room for slimes.
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFight_Failsafe: I know this all sounds like a lot, and a total long shot. But it’s our only chance.
GigiCore_StartFight_FailsafeLine03: I know this all sounds like a lot, and a total long shot. But it’s our only chance.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_Recap: Can you explain how all this is going to work again?
option.GigiCore_Recap: Can you explain how all this is going to work again?
CommStation|GigiCore_StartFightAltLine01: This is it, Beatrix. With the Harmonizers activated, and with your help, I can attempt to stabilize the Prismacore. Are you ready?
GigiCore_StartFightAltLine01: This is it, Beatrix. With the Harmonizers activated, and with your help, I can attempt to stabilize the Prismacore. Are you ready?
CommStation|option.GigiCore_StartFight_R: I’m ready to give it another shot.
option.GigiCore_StartFight_Retry: I’m ready to give it another shot.
CommStation|GigiCore_RetryFightLine02: When you’re ready, we can try this again. I believe in you.
GigiCore_RetryFightLine02: When you’re ready, we can try this again. I believe in you.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_IntroOptions: You know, your grandfather once gave me some great advice.
option.GigiCore_IntroOptions_Advice: You know, your grandfather once gave me some great advice.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_LookLine01: But where do we even start?
GigiCore_Intro_LookLine01: But where do we even start?
CommStation|option.GigiCore_IntroOptions: The only way to find something hidden is to look for it.
option.GigiCore_IntroOptions_Look: The only way to find something hidden is to look for it.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_IntroOptions: I’ve seen some funny looking walls here. Seems like a good place to start.
option.GigiCore_IntroOptions_Walls: I’ve seen some funny looking walls here. Seems like a good place to start.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_WallsLine01: Beatrix, that’s it! I kept thinking I’d find a door or something I couldn’t enter. But what if they’re hidden in plain sight? I… I think I could make some new tech that you could use to test this theory.
GigiCore_Intro_WallsLine01: Beatrix, that’s it! I kept thinking I’d find a door or something I couldn’t enter. But what if they’re hidden in plain sight? I… I think I could make some new tech that you could use to test this theory.
CommStation|GigiCore_Intro_WallsLine02: Head on over to the Exchange Station on the balcony above and I’ll get you set up!
GigiCore_Intro_WallsLine02: Head on over to the Exchange Station on the balcony above and I’ll get you set up!
CommStation|option.GigiCore_FightComplet: What happens to the Prismacore now?
option.GigiCore_FightComplete_Options_Pr: What happens to the Prismacore now?
CommStation|GigiCore_FightComplete_Prism: Time will tell, but I think it can remain here as yet another part of this world we all call home. Humans were never part of this world until we landed here one day, and now look at us! We managed to be a part of it all and not destroy it in the process. That’s the way it should be.
GigiCore_FightComplete_PrismacoreLine01: Time will tell, but I think it can remain here as yet another part of this world we all call home. Humans were never part of this world until we landed here one day, and now look at us! We managed to be a part of it all and not destroy it in the process. That’s the way it should be.
CommStation|GigiCore_FightComplete_Prism: Even the Prismacore was once lost out in the void of space before it landed here, and now it's part of this world too. It’s got to find its true place in all of this… just like me.
GigiCore_FightComplete_PrismacoreLine02: Even the Prismacore was once lost out in the void of space before it landed here, and now it's part of this world too. It’s got to find its true place in all of this… just like me.
CommStation|GigiCore_FightComplete_FreeL: I can feel a change in my arm. It's still connected somehow to the Prismacore, but it’s not like before. There is a quiet to it now, just a low hum of energy. It feels… peaceful.
GigiCore_FightComplete_FreeLine01: I can feel a change in my arm. It's still connected somehow to the Prismacore, but it’s not like before. There is a quiet to it now, just a low hum of energy. It feels… peaceful.
CommStation|GigiCore_FightComplete_FreeL: I will need to run more tests to truly know, but I think that I might finally be able to leave this chamber.
GigiCore_FightComplete_FreeLine02: I will need to run more tests to truly know, but I think that I might finally be able to leave this chamber.
CommStation|GigiCore_FightComplete_MomLi: There’s something I need to do out there. I need to finally talk to someone and let them know that my mom tried so hard — that I tried so hard and that I just couldn’t be that person. And that every day my mom felt such guilt about not being that person either…
GigiCore_FightComplete_MomLine01: There’s something I need to do out there. I need to finally talk to someone and let them know that my mom tried so hard — that I tried so hard and that I just couldn’t be that person. And that every day my mom felt such guilt about not being that person either…
CommStation|GigiCore_FightComplete_MomLi: I might not see you again for a while. I’m so sorry.
GigiCore_FightComplete_MomLine02: I might not see you again for a while. I’m so sorry.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_FightComplet: Sometimes our journeys take us away from our friends and those we love.
option.GigiCore_FightComplete_Options_Jo: Sometimes our journeys take us away from our friends and those we love.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_FightComplet: I once had someone tell me you need only to look up at the stars.
option.GigiCore_FightComplete_Options_St: I once had someone tell me you need only to look up at the stars.
CommStation|option.GigiCore_FightComplet: No matter how far you go, their light will touch you both.
option.GigiCore_FightComplete_Options_Li: No matter how far you go, their light will touch you both.
CommStation|GigiCore_FightComplete_Light: But what if where you are is beyond any distance, beyond time?

ResearchDrone|FieldsExpanseP1:
Accessing GG.Log:

Well, here we are again. I'm sending the drones out to all their original scouting locations. Once I confirm the conditions are the same I'll get to work. 

This place... I still remember being in awe of these rainbow fields. It felt like being in a beautiful dream.

And I guess in a way it was, because it ended much too soon.

ResearchDrone|ConservatoryP1:
Accessing GG.Log:

I had the drones rebuild the conservatory exactly as it was before. I was so happy to see it standing there again, its glass filtering the beautiful daylight of this magical place.

When it was done, for a moment I almost thought things were back to normal. I thought maybe I would just walk inside and start again like nothing had happened.

And though I know that's not the case, it was still so nice to finally be home again.

ResearchDrone|TheDenP1:
Accessing GG.Log:


Oh mushrooms, my first love. I still remember the day mom told me that they aren't actually plants, I couldn't believe it.

After I got that field guide, I would always sneak into the forest with grandma's old suitcase and collect as many as I could. When she found out, mom was so upset. But I think she was more upset about grandma's suitcase than anything else. I didn't know it was special to her.

ResearchDrone|TheGullyP1:
Accessing GG.Log:


I sometimes used to bring my lunch here and stare at these colossal fossils, wondering what this world looked like when they were alive. It's a world of slimes now but who knows what it was before?

And if the universe has room for a whole world and its ecosystem changing course, maybe we should accept the same of each other?

Jeez, talking about the past sure resonates these days. I wonder what profound thoughts I had to share back then?

ResearchDrone|TheTidepoolsP1:
Accessing GG.Log:


I used to be afraid of the water. It felt like it was endless and would just swallow you up. I was only ever willing to dip my feet in the shallows, where I could see the bottom, see the extent of it.

And now... what would you even call what I plunged into? Water so deep, so endless that I may never see the surface again.

I'm feeling sorry for myself again. I should get back to work.

I had been pacing all over the conservatory after it happened, my mind racing with what I should have done differently. I felt so guilty, so misguided. I ended up in these ruins, and I just slumped up against one of the walls, totally exhausted.

The stones were so solid and cold, and I felt the weight of the history they carried with them. And then a tiny bug crawling along one of the cracks in the wall slipped inside it and vanished. It passed through these ancient stones as if they were smoke.

That's when it all came to me.

PediaPage|m.desc.corral:
A corral is used to keep slimes on a ranch. The open-air corrals are designed for maximum slime satisfaction, with the rich soil of the Range beneath them and its expansive sky above them. Slimes will remain perfectly happy within corrals so long as they are fed regularly.

*Remember: You can shoot things THROUGH a corral barrier. Handy!*

PediaPage|m.desc.garden: The gardens used by ranchers use advanced technology to rapidly grow clones of fruits and veggies in a natural, though greatly sped up, way. By placing a sample into the replicator, the garden's soil is instantly populated by a fruit tree or veggie patch that will keep producing harvests until removed.

PediaPage|m.desc.coop: Though many ranchers simply let their chickens roam the ranch, a coop is the tool of the serious poultry producer. Coops keep hens and roostros close, allowing for maximum egg-laying potential. Just remember to avoid crowding the coop: chickens won't reproduce when in close proximity to a large number of other chickens. But give them room and watch the love bloom.

PediaPage|m.desc.incinerator: An incinerator will instantly burn anything it touches into ash, and then burn that ash into nothing. It's an excellent solution for eliminating a tarr outbreak or for simply disposing of unwanted slimes if you're a terrible, heartless monster.

PediaPage|m.desc.silo: A silo lets a rancher neatly store plorts and resources in a handy, compact unit. Simply shoot into an available silo port to fill it, or vac it to retrieve the items within. Remember, a clean ranch is a happy ranch!

PediaPage|m.desc.pond: A pond gives you a source of fresh water on the ranch that you can use for watering gardens, calming slimes in a corral, defeating tarr, or giving your puddle slimes a place to hang out and feed.

PediaPage|m.desc.archway: The Archway is an expansion to the conservatory set amongst grass-covered ruins from a time long ago. Pogo fruit and carrots grow between the cracks in the stone, making this a great spot for slimes that enjoy some fruit and veggies in their diet.

PediaPage|m.desc.den: Hidden within a large rounded hill resides the Den, an expansion to the conservatory. This dark, damp cave is a refuge from the sun for slimes and ranchers alike. Phosphor slimes in particular enjoy the mushroom-lined walls, while Batty slimes love to stretch their wings in their natural habitat.

PediaPage|m.desc.gully: The Gully is an expansion to the conservatory nestled between ancient, towering rock formations. While slimes enjoy frolicking in the amber fields of grass, Hen Hens nest in the cliffs, making this a meat-lover's paradise.

PediaPage|m.desc.tidepools: Perched on a low-lying peninsula, the Tidepools is like a vacation: a sandy getaway from a rancher's busy life in the conservatory. But slimes and other creatures like this place, too. Tall coral reef formations provide some respite from the sun, while shallow pools of water create an oasis for puddle slimes and other aquatic life.

PediaPage|m.desc.plort_market:
The plort market is a network of buyers and sellers of plorts across the galaxy. Ranchers use plort market machines on their ranch to send plorts to the market for sale. Ranchers are paid immediately when depositing plorts at the plort's current market value.

Plort market values fluctuate and some of the more savvy ranchers will hoard certain plorts for days when sale prices are high, especially rare plorts.

PediaPage|m.desc.chroma:
Chroma Packs can be applied from the terminal on the ranch earned in the 7Z Rewards Club. They allow you to apply color schemes you have earned to your ranch house, vacpack, and ranch tech such as corrals and silos.

You can acquire more chroma packs by continuing to rank up in the 7Z Rewards Club. Only the most successful ranchers will be able to show off the rarest chroma packs!

Puddle slimes are a rare species of slime that live in fresh water pools found on the range. These slimes don't eat fruits, veggies or meat like most other slimes. Instead, puddle slimes absorb water into their bodies while they sit on the surface of a pool.

Puddle slimes need fresh water to survive and will quickly evaporate if left on any other surface for too long.

PediaPage|m.risks.puddle_slime:
Puddle slimes aren't risky to manage, they just require a fair bit of maintenance. A rancher needs a pool of fresh water, like a pond, available for a puddle slime and its plorts to sit in as they will evaporate if away from water.

Finally, puddle slimes are exceptionally shy and will not produce plorts if they are in close proximity to more than 3 other slimes.

Overall, a puddle slime is a better fit for a more experienced rancher, not one still wet behind the ears.

Mosaic slimes can be very dangerous for an unprepared rancher. Their glass tiles create a shimmering effect in daylight that attracts other slimes to them. It is unknown why slimes exhibit this behavior exactly, but leading theories indicate that 'sparkly things are super cool.'

Even more dangerous, the mosaic slime can produce glints in the space around them: ultra-hot solar anomalies that grow in intensity before drifting toward the ground and bursting into flames. Glints can be snuffed with a splash of water, but the best way to reduce their appearance is to ensure your mosaic slimes are well-fed and not agitated.

Almost certainly, this glass is being studied because it's really pretty and not because it can cause devastating solar anomalies.

A dervish slime is a swirling, whirling bundle of energy in slimy form. Dervish slimes are sometimes found in areas with strong, windy weather, cruising across the landscape at high speed atop cyclones.

One thing is for certain: wherever the dervish slime needs to go, it gets there in a hurry.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.fire_slime:
Fire slimes are a rare breed of slime that lives on ash. Fire slimes will eat just about any food, but not without it being burned into ash first. The only way to feed a fire slime is to use an incinerator with an ash trough upgrade.

Fire slimes need ash to survive and will quickly snuff out if left on any other surface for too long. When keeping fire slimes in an ash trough, simply burn any food item to produce some ash and fill the trough.

Fire plorts are used in the developing world on Earth to keep stoves and fireplaces burning. Thanks to fire plorts, warm hands and hot food is a possibility for millions of people who otherwise would not have access to such luxuries.

A rancher won't get rich selling fire plorts, and certainly managing them can be a dangerous endeavour, but they should know that the sale of each helps those in need. Now and far into the future, the little noble actions of every individual help us move forward as a people. That much will never change.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.saber_slime:
Once believed to be long extinct or only existing as distant, feral descendants, saber slimes have been discovered on a mysterious glacier off the coast of Rainbow Island. And after being trapped in ice for ages, these saber slimes have awoken with dinosaur-sized appetites!

One of the fiercest predators during the Jellassic Period of the Far, Far Range, saber slimes still exhibit an extreme agility that makes them highly adept at hunting their favorite food, the elusive thundercluck. They can often be found bouncing off the sheer walls, slippery glaciers, and soaring ice spires of their snowy home.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.quicksilver_slime:
Quicksilver slimes are among the rarest slimes on the Far, Far Range, thanks in large part to their only known habitat being owned exclusively by Mochi Miles.

Quicksilver slimes are lightning quick, and feed on electricity. This is generally accomplished by their moving really fast and slowly accumulating the static charge they generate. However, Mochi has decided to speed up the process and created a method for feeding them energy in a far more direct fashion.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.glitch_slime:
Glitch slimes were formed from a bug in the codebase of Viktor's Slimeulation of the Far, Far Range. Though a wholly digital entity, these slimes could easily be considered 'real' within the limits of the world they inhabit.

Glitch slimes do not seek out food like physical slimes; instead, they seem to be expanding to every corner of the Slimeulation, driven by some unknown purpose.

Though glitch slimes pose no direct danger to a rancher, their mischievous nature can make for hazardous situations when attempting to wrangle them. Glitch slimes will take the form of other slimes, distinguishable only by the inaccurate face they present. Vac-ing them up or using debug spray will reveal their true form.

Additionally, a glitch slime can take the form of objects commonly found in the Far, Far Range. If you're familiar with the real range, look for objects like rocks and trees that don't seem to belong. A splash of debug spray can reveal many glitch slimes in disguise.

A glitch slime does not display any drive to eat the simulated food of the Slimeulation and so no known plorts exist.

However, if glitch slime plorts did exist, they would be virtual like everything in the Slimeulation and have no actual value. Unless of course, a bunch of people decided virtual plorts have value, and then maybe everyone would start buying them.

Heck, maybe eventually glitch slime plorts would be worth a fortune because a bunch of us just agree on that too and then we all created our own Slimeulations to generate glitch slime plorts.

But if that happened, then we would all be using an absurd amount of real energy, harming our real environment further, all to generate virtual plorts? 

So obviously, that's a very silly thing and we'd never do that.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.tarr_slime:
The tarr are formed when a largo eats a plort unlike the ones it produces. A terrible transformation occurs that turns the slime into a sludge filled with a swirling, prismatic array of colors and a relentless appetite. The tarr seek only to consume and replicate.

The only way to stop a tarr outside of incinerating it or throwing it into the slime sea is with fresh water. One splash will stop a tarr from spawning new tarr, and repeated splashes will destroy it entirely.

Alternatively many ranchers recommend running away with their arms waving, and screaming.

Remember: ranching largos may be highly profitable, but one stray plort and you could wind up with a devastating tarr outbreak.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.lucky_slime:
Lucky slimes are a strange variant of tabby slimes that seem to have a fascination with shiny objects, particularly newbuck coins. A lucky slime gobbles up any coin it can find, giving it a distinct jingling sound as they move about.

However, coins don't make for a balanced diet and a lucky slime will still greedily devour meat of any kind. In so doing, its body bursts with a shower of newbucks, having little room left in its slimy tummy. This burst often sends the lucky slime flying into the air.

Once detecting a rancher the lucky slime will soon make a hasty retreat. No known rancher has ever been skillful enough, or perhaps lucky enough, to capture one of these slippery slimes.

This occurrence has some of the more superstitious ranchers to see the lucky slime as a bad omen, or perhaps like the universe testing their greed. PediaPage|m.slimeology.gordo_slime:
Gordo slimes are a rare phenomenon that occurs when multiple slimes of the same type congregate. The result is that the slimes seem to merge together into a much larger slime that is seemingly incapable of movement.

A gordo will eat until it bursts, causing all the slimes to separate once more, as well as revealing whatever object it was that caused the gordo to form in the first place.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.largo_slime:
Largo slimes are a hybrid of two slimes resulting from a slime eating a plort unlike its own. They are twice as big normal slimes and have a combined diet of their two source slimes, making them enticing for ranchers that want to maximize their profits.

However, a largo is too big to vac and can only be transported using the end of the vac nozzle. This makes them difficult to control if things get out of hand.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.feral_slime:
Feral slimes are largos with a mean streak that will attack a rancher on sight. It's not known what exactly causes a largo to become so grumpy that it goes feral, but it's suspected that they've simply gone too long without a bite to eat. Like so many things with slimes, food is everything.

If a feral slime eats, it will revert to a normal largo.

The Party Gordo is a mysterious gordo slime that visits the Far, Far Range every weekend to bring the party to ranchers.

The party begins every Friday when the Party Gordo appears somewhere in the Far, Far Range. Find where the Party Gordo is hiding and pop it for a bunch of unique prizes.

But the party doesn't end there: for the duration of the weekend (all-day Friday, Saturday, and Sunday) you can randomly find special presents all over the Far, Far Range. Keep your eyes peeled!

Slime scientists have attempted to study this phenomenon and explain it but, like, you can't explain it. It's just party time.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.echo_note_gordo_s:
Few ranchers have ever even glimpsed a twinkle slime, with most believing it to be a legend. But those that have know it's real, and that the twinkle slime seems to be related to the passing of time, or a change in seasons. However, this is only a theory as data on twinkle slime behaviors is quite limited.

When they are found, twinkle slimes give away their location with the beautiful songs they sing. On approach, their song will reach a crescendo and all at once, vanish from sight and fill the immediate area with strange motes of energy called chimes.

Twinkle slimes also create a mysterious portal after they vanish that always wisks those who enter it back home.

It's not clear what purpose this serves, but some believe that the twinkle slime is reminding those who witness it that time passes whether you notice it or not, and when you do, it's sometimes nice to return home and remind yourself of the person you once were, and the people that made you who you are today.

PediaPage|m.slimeology.yolky_slime: Yolky slimes are a strange and elusive type of slime sometimes found near wild chickens on Rainbow Island. But unlike tabby slimes, their intent is not to hunt, for within their warm, golden center lies an enduring love for chickens. Such is the power of this glowing affection that it sometimes inspires nearby hens to produce a rare delight: a giant egg full of chicks and yolky plorts.

Slime ranchers should also note that giant eggs will only produce yolky plorts when they are fresh and the yolk inside is still glowing.

PediaPage|m.plortonomics.yolky_slime:
Yolky plorts are highly valued for their concentrated nutrients, containing an extremely potent variant of vitamin D that allows people to reduce their sunlight intake for long periods of time, making them popular with cosmic pioneers, deep sea explorers, and gamers. 

But though yolky plorts can replace the physical need for sunlight, they can never replace the warmth you feel when it touches your face, and the comfort it offers to know that the sun rose once more in your world. To be a stranger to that and still have hope for tomorrow would require the strongest of convictions.

PediaPage|m.desc.lemon:
A phase lemon comes from a different place and time. They are like an echo, a fading shadow, or a blur in the corner of your eye - never staying in the same place for long.

In order to harvest phase lemons a rancher must pass fruit matter through the phase lemon tree when lemons are present. This process somehow removes the fruit from our reality and phases in a lemon in exchange.

PediaPage|m.desc.lettuce:
Like a desert bloom or a deep sea pearl, water lettuce is a small miracle. The dry season can be difficult for wildlife on the Far, Far Range. But through the humble water lettuce, nature has found a way to provide.

The water stored inside the plant prevents its leaves from wilting under the sun's rays, and in turn the crisp leaves keep the water cool and protected, perfect for a thirsty critter in search of relief from the heat.

Chickadoos of all varieties will never be eaten by slimes. Some believe this is because slimes are too kind-hearted to do such a thing. Others believe it's because chickadoos don't yet have enough meat on their bones.

While appearing more or less like a big chicken, these burly birds are much more adept at fending for themselves, making them ideal for ranchers who might otherwise be distracted by a few hundred hungry slimes.

PediaPage|m.how_to_use.henhen: Hen hens in close proximity to roostros will periodically lay eggs that produce chickadoos. Savvy ranchers with an understanding of the complex nature of chicken romance will monitor growth rates in their coops and reduce density when growth begins to slow.

PediaPage|m.desc.painted_hen:
Painted hens are colorful chickens once found exclusively in a very distant region of the Far, Far Range known as the Glass Desert.

Given that the prismatic qualities of its flora match the plumage of a painted hen, could it be that these birds actually originated on Rainbow Island? If so, how did they also manage to get to the nearly impossible to reach Glass Desert? 

It all adds up to yet another incredible, chicken-related mystery in our universe.

Old sailors say that sea hens are actually demons in disguise, and that their vacant expressions are actually a diabolically calculated misdirect to hide evil intent. Plotting, waiting for their moment... to strike.

But this is probably not true. First of all, demons aren't real (seriously old sailors: read a science book). Second of all, sure, maybe they do have beady little eyes and emit unearthly shrieks whenever they spy a discarded candy wrapper buried in the sand... but, actually they're just hungry. Like, really hungry. Poor guys.
